description: This file contains code generated by a tool, defining extension methods, classes, interfaces, enums, and grain implementations related to testing host infrastructure in Orleans. The code also defines grain interfaces and implementations for fault injection testing, as well as code-generated serialization codecs and deep copiers for testing exceptions and references.
